I highly recommend this pharmacy. The pharmacist here is extremely knowledgeable, professional, and genuinely compassionate. She takes her role seriously and goes above and beyond to make sure customers understand their medications, how to take them properly, and what to expect.

What I really value is her attention to detail  especially when helping elderly patients who may be managing multiple prescriptions. She is thoughtful, careful, and patient when explaining how different medications interact and how to manage symptoms safely.

She has also given me practical health advice that has been very helpful. You can tell she cares about people’s well-being, not just about selling medicine.

If you’re looking for a trustworthy pharmacist in Chiang Mai who combines expertise with kindness, this is the place to go

After a long trip. I arrived to Chiang Mai with a sore throat and not feeling very well. But luckily my hotel was next to this pharmacy. Eve took care of me and I could start enjoying my trip. Totally recommend it. They speak really good English and  have knowledge about medicines.
Eve was a wealth of knowledge and comfort when I had a sore throat. She guided me to healthy choices, and did not try to upsell me on unnecessary extras. I highly recommend Eve Pharmacy.

Eve is a wonderful and lovely Pharmacist, who speaks fantastic English. I had a very pleasant conversation with her about my current health conditions, and overall life while living here in Thailand. She was very patient and attentive to my needs, answered all of my health related questions, and provided guidance with concise clarity. I currently live outside the old city, but I was recommended to Eve by a local Thai friend living in Samlan neighborhood. I will definitely make the short trip to Samlan to come back to Eve's Pharmacy whenever I need more medication and health consultation. Thank you Eve. 🙏

From the moment I stepped into the store, I was greeted with warm smiles and genuine interest in my needs. The staff took the time to listen to my concerns, and offered helpful advice on the best products to address my particular health issues.

What struck me most was the empathy and compassion they showed towards their customers. It was evident that they truly cared about the wellbeing of the people who walked through their doors.

The pharmacy itself was immaculate and well-organized, with a wide selection of products to choose from. The staff were incredibly knowledgeable, and I felt confident that I was in good hands.

It's rare to find a business that cares so deeply about its customers, and I would highly recommend it to anyone in the Chiang Mai area. Whether you're looking for prescription medications, herbal remedies, or personal care items, this pharmacy shop is sure to exceed your expectations.

I came to this pharmacy because it clearly stated that the pharmacists spoke English. I explained my problem to the pharmacist, but she didn't understand. So I used a translator. She pointed out two types of medication. I had trouble understanding the difference between them. I had to look it up online. I tried to communicate with her, but she said she didn't understand what I was saying. I eventually found what I needed. But I didn't feel reassured or helped at all. Why advertise in large letters on the window that they speak English if it's not true? In hindsight, I would have been better off going to another pharmacy, where the staff might have been more welcoming and helpful, even if it meant using a translator the whole time.
